inputs.text:
A single continuous five-second 2D anime medium shot, waist-up, locked camera. Preserve the girl and the composition of the input image: long dark navy hair, black sweater, white collar and red tie, standing on the right, quiet Tokyo house facades across the street. Consistent clean outlines and restrained cel shading.

First, she gently turns her head from looking toward screen left to looking toward the camera. Begin the turn near the start of the shot. Use a small, continuous head rotation that eases to a stop; her torso and shoulders stay almost still. Her eyes follow the turn naturally. No walking or head tilt.

As she finishes turning, quiet surprise gradually develops: a slight eyebrow lift, subtly raised upper eyelids, and lips parting into a small narrow opening. Her jaw barely moves. Preserve her normal eye size and facial proportions. The expression is attentive and softly surprised, not frightened. Her face changes continuously through intermediate expressions rather than snapping to a new drawing.

Then a clearly visible gust from behind and slightly to her right lifts the loose lengths of her hair away from her shoulders and carries their ends toward screen left. Several broad locks bend and trail with overlapping motion; the tips follow the upper lengths with a gentle delay. The hair roots stay attached naturally. Keep her eyes and mouth unobstructed. Her head remains nearly still while the hair moves independently.

Finally the gust eases, with the hair tips still softly swaying. She holds her gaze near the camera and her restrained surprised expression. Fixed background, fixed framing, unchanged lighting, no cuts.

static frozen hair, rigid hair mass, abrupt facial switching, face morphing,
identity change, exaggerated surprise, huge round open mouth, screaming,
talking, bulging eyes, repeated head turns, full body rotation, walking,
hair covering eyes or mouth, hair growing, chaotic violent wind,
camera movement, zoom, cuts, line flicker, warped background,
extra people, extra limbs, outfit changes, text, watermark
